industry: Autonomous maritime systems, GPS-free navigation and computer vision
summary: Företag 3 develops software, hardware and algorithms for GPS-free positioning, tracking and navigation, including maritime computer vision applications. The company focuses on autonomous maritime systems designed for defence and security applications.
target_market: European defence and maritime autonomy market
strategy_notes: Focused on developing scalable autonomous maritime capabilities with resilient navigation and mission execution in denied or degraded communications environments.
technology_notes: Core technologies include GPS-free positioning, autonomous navigation, computer vision and software-defined maritime autonomy systems.
risk_notes: Dependent on defence procurement cycles, technology validation, regulatory requirements, funding availability and competition from established defence technology providers.
